title: Descent of colimiting cocones through a universe inclusion
statement: Use the universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the spaces, coherent diagrams, cocones, colimits and equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Write $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ and $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'}$ for the infinity categories of spaces in the respective universes, formed in a further ambient universe, and let $\iota:\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'}$ be the fully faithful universe inclusion of [lem-coef-spaces-small-colimits-universe]. For every $\mathcal U$-small simplicial set $I$, coherent diagram $H:I\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$, and cocone $\lambda:H\to\Delta_I M$ with $M\in\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$, a small-space colimit $Q=\operatorname{colim}_I H$ exists. If the image cocone $\iota\lambda$ is colimiting in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U'}$, then $\lambda$ is colimiting in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ and its induced comparison $\alpha:Q\to M$ is an equivalence. For every such comparison, $\alpha$ is an equivalence if and only if $\iota(\alpha)$ is an equivalence.
